title: Abandoned Cart Recovery
content: Build abandoned cart recovery UI. Exit intent modal: triggered when user moves to leave with items in cart. Content: "Leaving so soon?" message, cart contents preview, discount incentive offer. Actions: "Complete Purchase" CTA, "Save for Later" secondary, "No Thanks" dismiss. Email capture: if not logged in, offer to email cart link. Return visit: show notification bar with saved cart items.

variants.simple: Create abandoned cart reminder modal or notification.
variants.detailed: Build abandoned cart recovery UI. Exit intent modal: triggered when user moves to leave with items in cart. Content: "Leaving so soon?" message, cart contents preview, discount incentive offer. Actions: "Complete Purchase" CTA, "Save for Later" secondary, "No Thanks" dismiss. Email capture: if not logged in, offer to email cart link. Return visit: show notification bar with saved cart items.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive abandoned cart recovery system with multiple touchpoints. Exit intent modal: triggered when mouse moves toward browser close/tab (desktop), or inactivity timeout (mobile). Modal content: friendly headline "Wait! You left something behind" or "Leaving so soon?", cart preview showing items (1-3 items with images, names, quantities), total value display, optional urgency ("Your cart is reserved for 10 minutes" or "Items selling fast"), incentive offer (if enabled): "Complete your order now and get 10% off" with auto-applied code, or free shipping offer, CTA: "Complete My Purchase" primary button going to checkout, "Save Cart" secondary option saving cart to account or emailing link, "No Thanks" dismiss link. Save cart functionality: for guests, email capture form "Enter email to save your cart", sends email with cart restoration link, for logged in, cart persisted to account automatically. Return visit notification: sticky bar or toast on return: "Welcome back! You have X items in your cart", quick link to cart, show first item thumbnail, dismiss after interaction or timeout. Email sequence: automated emails for abandoned carts. Email 1 (1 hour): "You left items behind" with cart contents, no discount. Email 2 (24 hours): gentle reminder, optional small incentive. Email 3 (48-72 hours): stronger incentive or urgency ("Items selling fast"). Each email: personalized cart contents, direct link to restored cart, one-click checkout if possible, unsubscribe option. Push notifications: if user has push enabled, abandoned cart reminder notification. SMS: for high-value carts or opted-in users. In-app notification: for mobile app users. Stock alerts: if cart items going low stock, urgent notification "Only 2 left!". Price drop: if cart item goes on sale, notify "Item in your cart is now $X cheaper!". Admin dashboard: abandoned cart analytics showing recovery rate, revenue recovered, best-performing incentives. Targeting: different messages based on cart value, user history, product category. A/B testing: test different incentive levels, messaging, timing. Suppression: don't show recovery UI to users who just completed checkout, respect frequency caps. Legal: comply with email marketing laws, clear unsubscribe. Accessibility: modal accessible with proper focus management, clear dismiss option.
